ModMetaData.name: Raid Approach Profiler
ModMetaData.author: OldManYoung
ModMetaData.description:
Development diagnostic mod for investigating periodic MarketValue and Lord-related performance spikes while hostile raiders approach a player colony.
This development version does not modify gameplay behavior. It only verifies that the mod assembly and Harmony can load successfully.
This is unofficial community-created content and is not endorsed by Ludeon Studios.
